avis.titre: Thought it would be great... it sucked
avis.texte: The only problem I have with my skin is that it's very oily. My pores are naturally very small and my skins not too prone to breaking out unless I'm eating lots of oily food or not drinking enough water. After the first use I loved this, it left my face matte and helped clear up a couple pimples i had at the time. A few days later however i noticed that my pores had gotten bigger so to give the product a fair chance i stopped using it to see if my pores would shrink again, in case it was a diet thing, and then go back to it. After about a week I started using the face wash again and not only did my pores get bigger again but, my skin had started to peel, and my skin was much more susceptible to breaking out ( I've watched a line of four huge pimples grow on my cheek overnight and my forehead get covered with smaller ones). This is my second Clinique oil control product that has completely flopped for me and I don't plan on buying another from them.

Feels so clean in my skin though i have an oily skin which this product help to kill my oily skin it gives me a cool feeling after washing and i feel this works for me and no break outs at all...i recommend this product to follow with men's clinique oil control mattifying expoliating toner use this toner with cotton balls to cleanse more then to follow with the mattifying oil control moisturizer...ive been doing the routine mornings and nights...loving it...

avis.titre: My son's face never looked so great
avis.texte: Bought this for my teenage son who started having incredible blemishes and breakouts, after 2+ days of using it, we could see a huge difference. If he does not use it for a couple days, you can tell because his face starts breaking out again. This stuff is AWESOME.

avis.titre: Not What I Expected from Clinique
avis.texte: I have used other Clinique products before but this was the first Men's product I have ever purchased. Sadly, I was disappointed. It actually made my skin more oily and shiney. I thought as a guy, this would be perfect since my skin is already oily but sadly after 9 days of use, I needed to discontinue as I saw no results, only adverse ones. The product did not make my skin feel clean or refreshing like other Clinique products. Therefore, I returned it and exchanged it for what I know works and for a product I do like. I currently use Clinique Foaming Sonic Facial Soap. Now this product works and feels great!
